tagline: Simple notes, powered by GitHub Issues.

connect.intro: Notes are saved as Issues in your own private GitHub repository.
connect.tokenHelp: Choose Only select repositories, select your notes repository, and grant Issues: Read and write. No Contents or administration access is needed.
connect.privacy: Your connection is saved with encryption in this browser and restored when you return. Disconnect in Settings to remove it. Use a browser you trust.
connect.remember: Remember this connection in this browser
connect.sessionPrivacy: Your token stays in this tab’s memory and is cleared when you reload or close it. Your notes and drafts stay on this device.
connect.cacheHelp: Cached notes are available without a token. They are not protected by a separate local login.
connect.privateOnly: Use a private repository owned by your GitHub account.

home.searchTooDense: Over 1,000 matching Issues were created in the same second. Narrow your search to retrieve all results.
home.emptyDescription: Capture a thought, save a link, or make a little list.
home.noResultsDescription: Try another search or adjust your filters.
home.issuesDescription: Your existing Issues stay unchanged until you choose to turn one into a note.
home.loading: Loading Issues — these results may be incomplete.
home.offline: You’re offline. Changes stay on this device until you reconnect.
home.disconnected: Working locally. Connect to GitHub to sync your changes.
home.readonly: This repository is open for editing in another tab. This tab is read-only.
home.unsupportedLock: This browser cannot safely coordinate editing between tabs. Reading and export are available.
home.unavailable: This Issue could not be found in the latest full scan. Your local copy is preserved.
home.invalid: This Issue’s note metadata cannot be read. Its original content is preserved.
home.unsupported: This note uses a newer format. Update Tebikae before editing it.

note.remoteUpdated: GitHub has a newer version of this note. Your current editor text is preserved.
note.title: Title
note.localError: Couldn’t save on this device. Keep this window open and export your text.
note.deleteConfirm: Delete this note forever? Its GitHub Issue will be deleted and cannot be restored.
note.deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete the note. Check your connection and try again.
note.limits: Titles: up to 120 characters. Notes: up to 40,000 characters.
note.duplicate: More than one Issue has this note’s ID. Automatic writes are paused.
note.duplicateHelp: The other Issues receive new note IDs and remain separate copies.
note.uncertain: GitHub may have received your last request. Check again before creating another Issue.
note.retryWarning: The previous request may still succeed. Creating again could make a duplicate. Continue?
note.conflictHelp: Your local edits and GitHub changed the same content. Choose which version to keep; a recovery copy is saved on this device.

label.name: Label name
label.createHelp: Create a label in this repository. Add it to notes to keep related ideas together.
label.connectedRequired: Connect to GitHub to create labels.

backupImport.title: Import JSON backup
backupImport.help: Restore selected notes as independent copies in this notebook. Existing notes are never overwritten. When synchronization runs, the copies create new GitHub Issues.
backupImport.coverage: Choose a Tebikae JSON export (up to 20 MiB and 2,000 notes). Restore the saved local version of each note, including drafts and conflicts. Recovery history, ordinary Issues, credentials, and previous sync attempts are not imported.
backupImport.summary: {{valid}} available · {{duplicates}} already imported or repeated · {{invalid}} invalid
backupImport.missing: These labels have no exact match in this notebook: {{names}}. They will be omitted. Other labels are matched by name, never by source repository ID.
backupImport.trashHelp: Trash is unselected by default. Select it explicitly to restore it. Unchanged records previously imported into this notebook are skipped; changed backup records become new copies.
backupImport.success: Saved {{imported}} new local notes. Skipped {{skipped}} records already imported.
backupImport.syncHelp: Your copies are saved on this device and queued for normal synchronization. Offline copies will sync when the connection returns.

errors.size: This backup exceeds the 20 MiB limit.
errors.read: This file could not be read. Choose an accessible local copy and try again.
errors.json: This file is not valid JSON. Choose a Tebikae JSON export.
errors.format: This is not a supported Tebikae JSON backup, or its label list is invalid.
errors.version: This backup uses an unsupported format version.
errors.count: This backup exceeds the limit of 2,000 notes.
errors.selection: The preview has changed. Choose the backup again to refresh it.
errors.readonly: Import requires editing access in this tab. Enable editing in the notebook first.
errors.storage: The import could not be saved. No notes were partially imported. Free up device storage and try again.

markdownExport.title: Export Markdown ZIP
markdownExport.help: Download your current notes as Markdown files, organized into notes, archive, and trash folders. Duplicate titles get separate filenames. A manifest preserves labels, note properties, and sync status.
markdownExport.coverage: This preview captures notes and unsynced drafts stored on this device. It does not fetch from GitHub. Comments, attachment files, ordinary Issues, and recovery copies are excluded; use JSON export for recovery copies.
markdownExport.empty: No notes to export with these options.
markdownExport.failed: Could not prepare the Markdown export. Your notes are unchanged. Please try again.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.tokenStorage: Your connection is encrypted and saved in this browser so you can return without filling it in again. Disconnecting or closing the notebook removes the saved connection. Your notes stay on this device.
settings.tokenMemory: This connection is not saved. Your token stays in this tab’s memory and is cleared when you disconnect, reload or close it.
settings.dataHelp: Notes and drafts are cached in this browser. GitHub stores your synced Markdown. Neither copy is end-to-end encrypted.
settings.exportHelp: Export loaded Issues, notes, drafts, and recovery copies. Comments and attachment files are not included.
settings.partial: This export contains only the Issues loaded on this device.
settings.clearHelp: Remove this repository’s local cache and drafts. Your GitHub Issues stay in the repository.
settings.clearConfirm: Clear local data for this repository? {{count}} notes have changes that are not synced. Export them first if you need a copy.
settings.forceUpdateHelp: Clears cached app files and reloads to pick up the latest version. Your saved login and notes are not affected.
settings.persistDenied: The browser did not grant persistent storage. Keep a separate export of important drafts.
settings.syncLimit: GitHub sync runs while the app is open. Closing the app pauses sync.
settings.recoveries: Recovery copies are included in JSON exports.

error.sessionNotSaved: Connected, but this browser couldn’t save the connection securely. You’ll need to enter your token again after closing or reloading the page.
error.sessionRestoreFailed: Couldn’t restore the saved connection. Reconnect to sync; your cached notes and drafts are still available.
error.sessionForgetFailed: Sync has stopped, but the saved connection couldn’t be removed. Try again, or clear this site’s data in your browser after exporting your notes.
error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your token has expired or is invalid. Reconnect to sync.
error.FORBIDDEN: GitHub denied this action. Check your token’s Issues permission.
error.NOT_FOUND_OR_INACCESSIBLE: This repository or Issue is unavailable. Check the connection and permissions.
error.ISSUES_DISABLED: Issues are disabled for this repository.
error.RATE_LIMITED: GitHub asked us to wait. Your edits remain saved locally.
error.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the repository name, title length, and note content.
error.NETWORK_UNCERTAIN: The request could not be confirmed. Your local content is preserved.
error.SERVER_ERROR: GitHub is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.PRIVATE_REQUIRED: Choose a private repository for your notes.
error.OWNER_REQUIRED: Choose a repository owned by your GitHub account.
error.ARCHIVED_REPOSITORY: This repository is archived and cannot accept edits.
error.SESSION_EXPIRED: This connection has ended. Reconnect to continue syncing.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Your unsaved text is still available in the editor.
error.storage: This browser could not open local storage. Allow site storage, then reload.

context.deleteLabelConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” from the GitHub repository and every note using it? The notes themselves will not be deleted.
context.clearTrashConfirm_one: Permanently delete {{count}} trashed note? This cannot be undone.
context.clearTrashConfirm_other: Permanently delete {{count}} trashed notes? This cannot be undone.
context.clipboardError: Clipboard access failed. Use the system copy/paste shortcut or native text menu.
